t: A clock which moves continuously fast, it lags 10 minutes on Tuesday 10 AM, it is ahead 14 minutes on Friday 10 AM. Find when the clock showed the right time.
e: Time between Tuesday 10 AM to Friday 10 AM = 72 hour Formula: X Total = X 72 = X 72 = 30 hour Tuesday 10 AM + 30 hour = Wednesday 4 PM
h: एक घड़ी जो लगातार तेज चलती है, मंगलवार सुबह 10 बजे यह 10 मिनट पीछे रहती है, शुक्रवार सुबह 10 बजे यह 14 मिनट आगे रहती है। बताइए घड़ी ने सही समय कब दिखाया।

t: What will be the acute angle between the hour-hand and the minute-hand at 6:41 am?
e: The acute angle between the hour-hand and the minute-hand at 6:41 am can be calculated using this formula - Angle = |M - 30H| Where, M = Minutes, H = Hours M = 41, H = 6 Angle = | X 41 - 30 X 6| = | - 180| = |225.5 - 180| = |45.5| Angle = 45.5

t: At what time between 8 O'Clock and 9 O'Clock, will the minute hand and hour hand of the clock make right angles?
e: To determine when the minute hand and hour hand of a clock will form right angles between 8:00 and 9:00, we can use the following approach: Position of the hour hand: At 8:00, the hour hand is at 240 degrees (each hour represents 30 degrees, so 8 X 30=240). The hour hand moves at a rate of 0.5 degrees per minute (since it moves 30 degrees in 60 minutes). Therefore, after m minutes past 8:00, the position of the hour hand will be: Hour hand position= 240+0.5m Position of the minute hand: The minute hand starts at 0 degrees at 8:00 and moves at a rate of 6 degrees per minute (since it moves 360 degrees in 60 minutes). After m minutes past 8:00, the position of the minute hand will be: Minute hand position=6m Finding right angles: The minute hand and hour hand will be at right angles (90 degrees apart) if: ∣Minute hand position−Hour hand position∣=90 This gives us two cases to solve: Case 1: 6m−(240+0.5m)=90 6m - 240 - 0.5m=90 5.5m=90+240 5.5m=330 m=60 minutes, which is not possible as it exceed 60 minutes. So, case 1 gets cancelled. Case 2: 6m - (240+0.5m)=-90 6m - 240 - 0.5m=-90 5.5m=-90+240 5.5m=150 m=27.27 8 hours 27.27 minutes Seconds = 0.27 X 60 seconds = 16.2 16 Thus, the hands of the clock will make right angles at 8:27:16. Alternative method: By using formulae: Case 1: Right angle = 90 Angle between two hands = M - 30H Where H is Hours and M is Minutes Here Hour = 8 and Angle = 90 90 = M - 30 X 8 90 = M - 240 M = 330 M = M = 60 Hence, the required time = 8:60, which is not possible as it exceed 60 minutes. Case 2: Right angle = -90 Angle between two hands = M - 30H Where H is Hours and M is Minutes Here Hour = 8 and Angle =- - 90 -90 = M - 30 X 8 -90 = M - 240 M = 150 M = M=27.27 8 hours 27.27 minutes Seconds = 0.27 X 60 seconds = 16.2 16 Thus, the hands of the clock will make right angles at 8:27:16.

t: Find the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock when the time is 36 minutes past 2.
e: 36 minutes past 2 means 2:36 The angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock when the time is 2:36 can be calculated by using the formula - Angle = |M - 30H| Where, M = Minutes, H = Hours M = 36, H = 2 Angle = | X 36 - 30 X 2| = |198 - 60| = |138| Angle = 138

t: A clock shows 1:00 in the morning. By how much angle will the hours hand rotate when the clock shows 8:00 in the morning?

t: If a clock shows 3 hours 23 minutes, how much angle does the minute and hour hand make?
e: The angle between hour hand and minute hand when the clock show 3 hours 23 minutes is given by: Angle = [(11/2)*M - 30*H] Where, M = minutes and H = hour So, Angle = [(11/2)*23 - 30*3] Angle = [126.5 - 90] Angle = 36.5

t: Find the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock when the time is 29 minutes past 11.
e: 29 minutes past 11 means 11:29 The angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock when the time is 11:29 can be calculated by using the formula - Angle = |M - 30H| Where, M = Minutes, H = Hours M = 29, H = 11 Angle = | X 29 - 30 X 11| = |159.5 - 330| = |-170.5| Angle = 170.5

e: The hour hand of a clock moves by 30 when the minute hand moves through 360. Hence if the hour hand moves 21, then the minute hand moves by - X 21 = 12 X 21 = 252

t: In 24 hours, how many times do the minute and hour hands of a clock overlap?
e: Overlaps happen 11 times per 12 hours, so 22 times in 24 hours.
h: 24 घंटों में मिनट और घंटे की सुई कितनी बार ओवरलैप करती हैं?
eh: हर 12 घंटे में 11 बार ओवरलैप होता है, इसलिए 24 घंटे में 22 बार।

t: In 24 hours, how many times will the minute and hour hands be opposite to each other?
e: Hands are opposite 11 times per 12 hours, so 22 times in 24 hours.

eh: हर 12 घंटे में 11 बार विपरीत होती हैं, इसलिए 24 घंटे में 22 बार।

t: A clock is 3 minutes fast at 11:30 AM and 9 minutes fast at 11:30 PM. At what time (AM) will it show the correct time?
e: Gain increases by 6 minutes every 12 hours. Using the standard proportion method for such clock-error problems, the correct time is shown at 5:30 AM.
h: एक घड़ी 11:30 AM पर 3 मिनट तेज़ है और 11:30 PM पर 9 मिनट तेज़। यह सही समय किस समय (AM) दिखाएगी?
eh: हर 12 घंटे में तेज़ी 6 मिनट बढ़ती है। मानक अनुपात विधि से हल करने पर सही समय 5:30 AM आता है।

t: In 12 hours, how many times will the minute and hour hands be opposite each other?
e: The hands are opposite exactly 11 times in every 12-hour period.
h: 12 घंटों में मिनट और घंटे की सुई कितनी बार विपरीत (180 डिग्री) होंगी?
eh: हर 12 घंटे में सुइयाँ ठीक 11 बार विपरीत होती हैं।

t: A clock is 5 minutes fast at 11:30 AM and 11 minutes fast at 11:30 PM. At what time (AM) will it show correct time?
e: Gain increases by 6 minutes every 12 hours; extrapolating forward with the proportion method gives correct time at 1:30 AM.
h: एक घड़ी 11:30 AM पर 5 मिनट तेज़ है और 11:30 PM पर 11 मिनट तेज़। सही समय किस समय (AM) दिखाएगी?
eh: हर 12 घंटे में तेज़ी 6 मिनट बढ़ती है; अनुपात विधि से हल करने पर सही समय 1:30 AM आता है।

t: A clock is 5 minutes fast at 10:00 AM and 15 minutes fast at 4:00 PM. At what time (AM) will it show correct time?
e: Gain increases by 10 minutes over 6 hours; extrapolating forward with the proportion method gives correct time at 7:00 AM the next day.

t: A clock set right at 4 AM on 15 May loses 20 seconds every hour. What will it show at 4 AM on 16 May?
e: In 24 hours it loses 24x20=480 seconds = 8 minutes, so it shows 4:00 - 8min = 3:52 AM.
h: 15 मई को 4 AM पर सही की गई घड़ी हर घंटे 20 सेकंड धीमी होती है। 16 मई को 4 AM पर घड़ी क्या समय दिखाएगी?
eh: 24 घंटे में यह 480 सेकंड = 8 मिनट धीमी होती है, अतः यह 3:52 AM दिखाएगी।

t: A clock is set at 3 pm today. It gains 'p' minutes in every 1 hour. If it will show 9 hours 40 minutes pm at 7 pm tomorrow, then find the value of 'p'.
e: Time gain by the clock in every one hour = p minutes Total hours from 3 pm today to 7 pm tomorrow = 24 + 4 = 28 hours Time gain by the clock in 28 hours = 28p minutes Also, time gain by the clock = (9 hours 40 minutes pm) - 7pm = 2 hours + 40 minutes 2 hours + 40 minutes = 28p minutes => 2 * 60 + 40 = 28p => p = 160/28 => p = 5(5/7)
h: आज एक घड़ी दोपहर 3 बजे सेट की गई है। यह हर 1 घंटे में 'p' मिनट आगे बढ़ती है। यदि यह कल शाम 7 बजे 9 घंटे 40 मिनट अपराह्न दिखाएगी, तो 'p' का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: Time shown in a clock is 8:29, what time will appear in the water?
e: If Minute is less than 30, then subtract the given time from 18:30 hours. If Minute is more than 30, then subtract the given time from 17:90 hours. Here, time is 8:29, so 1 st formula is applicable. Time in water = (18:30 - 8:29) = 10:01
h: घड़ी में 8:29 बज रहे हैं, पानी में क्या समय दिखाई देगा?

t: Find the angle traced by the hour hand of a clock between 5 pm and 9:30pm of the same day?
e: We know that, each clock is composed on 360° that is divided into 12 equal regions. So, the angle between the consecutive divisions is obtained by dividing the total angle of clock 360° by the number of divisions i.e. 12. Thus, the angle between any two consecutive divisions = (360°)/12= 30°. In other words, the angle formed by an hour hand in 1 hour = 30° and the angle formed by an hour hand in 30 minutes = 30°/2 = 15°. From 5pm to 9:30 pm, total number of hours = 4 hours 30 minutes. So, angle = 4*30° + 15° = 120° + 15° = 135°.
h: एक ही दिन शाम 5 बजे से रात 9:30 बजे के बीच घड़ी की घंटे की सुई द्वारा बनाया गया कोण ज्ञात कीजिए?

t: At what time between 6 o' clock and 10 o' clock will the hands of a clock be at angle of 117°?
e: We have to find angle of 117° between 6 o' clock and 10 o' clock. So, H = 6 A = 117° So, T = 2/11 * [H*30±A] T = 2/11 * [6*30+117] T = 2/11 * [180+117] T = 2/11 * 297 T = 2*27 T = 54 So, at 6 hours 54 minutes, the hands of a clock be at angle of 117°.
h: 6 बजे से 10 बजे के बीच किस समय घड़ी की सुइयां 117° के कोण पर होंगी?

t: What is the measure of the smaller of the two angles formed between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock when it is 6:51 p.m.?

t: A clock is set at 5.00 am in the morning. How many degrees would the hour hand have cumulative covered, when the time is 10 am?
e: Total time from 5.00 am to 10 am = 5 hours We know, degrees covered by the hour hand in 1 hour = 30° Therefore, degrees covered by the hour hand in 5 hours = 5 * 30° = 150°

t: What will be the angle between two needles of the clock (hour and minute) at 9 hours 36 minutes?
e: Time = 9 : 36 Here, Hours = 9 & Minutes = 36 Angle between two needles of the clock = [(60 X hours) - (11 X minutes)] / 2 = [60 X 9 - 11 X 36] / 2 = [540 - 396] / 2 = 144 / 2 = 72º

t: A clock is set right at 7 p.m. The clock gains 12 minutes in every 3 hours. If, later the day, the actual time is 10: 15 p.m., then what will be the time shown in the watch?
e: The duration between 7 p.m. to 10: 20 p.m. = 3 hours 15 minutes According to the question, in 3 hours it gains 12 minutes. In 1 hours it gains (12/3 = 4) minutes. In 1 minute, it gains (4/60) minutes = (1/15) minutes. And, in 15 minutes, it gains (15 x (1/15)) minutes = 1 minute Then, in 3 hours 15 minutes, it gains (4 x 3 + 1) = 13 minutes Therefore, the time shown by the faulty watch will be = 10: 15 p.m. + 13 minutes = 10: 28 p.m.
